about: Flash's repair budget (SKILL.md, "Flash repairs"). A refusing script prints `h2wp-signature: <key>`; the key names the failure, and its levers are the only repairs Flash may try for it, in this order. progress.sh repair counts every attempt: 9 per run, at most 3 per stage (3 per owner message on a stopped run), never the same named lever on the same failure twice; when a failure's named levers are spent, or no script named it (`unnamed`), the attempts left are the AI's own diagnosed fix (`ai-fix`). A remedy is followed by the failing command again, then progress.sh repaired.

manifest-undecided.what: check-manifest.py --flash names what the manifest leaves undecided

listing-unwired.what: preflight-listings.mjs refuses a blog or shop listing's selectors

preview-down.what: the preview WordPress did not come up, or install-theme could not reach it

article-part-foreign.what: make-zip refuses parts/article.html: its classes are not this site's, so every post would render in a foreign skeleton

form-field-unnamed.what: normalize-form-fields could not name a form's field (ambiguous, or not uniquely locatable), so Visual Edit Lite cannot connect that form

menu-unwired.what: gate C: a navigation the manifest declares does not render its WordPress menu on the live site (verify-wp menusWired)

cart-count-missing.what: after add to cart, the header shows no cart count

cart-count-stale.what: changing the quantity or removing an item in the cart does not update the header count

cart-options-merged.what: two options of one product (two sizes) went into the cart as one line

prereq-missing.what: a tool the conversion needs is missing on this machine

unnamed.what: a failure that stops the run and that no script named with h2wp-signature

manifest-decide.label: decide what the manifest leaves open
manifest-decide.remedy: Write exactly what check-manifest names into conversion-manifest.json (SKILL.md, "Stage 0 in Flash").

listing-selector.label: the listing selector preflight names
listing-selector.remedy: Apply exactly the lever preflight-listings names (the `>` path that works, the card selector) to the manifest's blog or shop entry.

listing-static.label: leave that listing static
listing-static.remedy: Set that listing's blog (or shop) to "present": false with the reason "Flash: the listing's selectors could not be wired (preflight-listings.json)" — the rest converts; the report names it.

preview-again.label: bring the preview WordPress up again
preview-again.remedy: test-env.sh up <slug> once more, from the workspace — it is idempotent; the upload is not repeated.

article-part-residue.label: the article layout from the site's own article
article-part-residue.remedy: Derive parts/article.html from the site's own article page with the [wp-article] fields.

article-part-other-page.label: the article layout from another article, or a named region
article-part-other-page.remedy: Derive it from another article page, or name the region: article-part.py --from <an article page> (or set blog.articleMain / blog.articleBody to the article's real region and run it again).

form-field-names.label: name the form's fields
form-field-names.remedy: Give the field normalize-form-fields names as ambiguous or not locatable a name in the input page ({input}/<page>) — the name its label or placeholder says — or give the radios a <fieldset><legend>.

menu-wiring.label: wire the menu
menu-wiring.remedy: Replace the static navigation in the header or footer part with the menu token the other menus use (the same [wp-menu …] form, the nav's own markup inside), then apply it into the preview.
menu-wiring.again: python3 $S/apply-change.py {workspace} --repair 5 --what "wire the menu", then the check that was red

cart-count.label: the cart count in every header, in step with the cart
cart-count.remedy: python3 $S/woo-shims.py {workspace} --cart-count --cart-sync — the count token in every cart link of every header part (the design's own badge from the cart specimen, else a neutral one) and the script that keeps it in step with the block cart and the Store API — then into the preview. Stage 5.6 runs it for you: $S/woo-repair.py {workspace}.

size-as-cart-attribute.label: the chosen option goes into the cart line
size-as-cart-attribute.remedy: python3 $S/woo-shims.py {workspace} --option-cart-data — a chosen option (a size, a colour) of a product with no variations becomes the cart line's own data, shown in the cart, the checkout and the order, so two sizes are two lines — then into the preview. Stage 5.6 runs it for you: $S/woo-repair.py {workspace}.
size-as-cart-attribute.again: python3 $S/apply-change.py {workspace} --repair 5.6 --what "options as cart lines", then python3 $S/audit-woo-coverage.py --wp <url> --workspace {workspace} --probe-cart

prereqs-again.label: check the prerequisites again
prereqs-again.remedy: The owner installed what check-prereqs named; run it again.

ai-fix.label: the AI's own diagnosed fix
ai-fix.remedy: Read the failing command's output and logs, find the cause, and change only what causes it (never a gate, a check or its thresholds). Say in the close note what you changed and why.
